text: Bitcoin's 8.2% surge is outpacing Ethereum's 4.2% gain, pushing BTC dominance to 59.2% and signaling risk appetite favoring larger-cap assets. The Fear & Greed index at 72 (greed) with a sharp 43-point weekly climb indicates sentiment has swung sharply toward optimism, though volume at $136B remains moderate relative to the move. Altcoins like ETH, SOL, and BNB are rising in absolute terms but losing relative ground, consistent with a flight to Bitcoin during periods of renewed confidence.
